notes.title: Flathead launches May 30th
notes.notes:
We’re excited to be launching a new game on Thursday (May 30th). The first in a series meant to bring back the spirit of the Dread X Collections comes Flathead. If you loved the collections, FLATHEAD is very likely what you’ve been waiting for, head on over and check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2840480/FLATHEAD/

In the vein of the collection games, FLATHEAD is a compact, re-playable horror experience. Play a game of skill and luck for the highest of stakes… your very existence.

From Tim Oxton//Oxblud, the creator of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468250/silkbulb_test/]Silkbulb Test[/url] comes FLATHEAD, the first title of the XP Ultra program. XP Ultra is our way of continuing to create smaller, weirder experiences like those enjoyed by so many as part of the Collections in a sustainable way both for developers and crew. Does this mean there’s never going to be another Dread X Collection?  No, we wanted to be able to bring you smaller games more often than we would if they were only part of a collection. The future is unknowable.

[previewyoutube=kGLzrnwUF7E;full][/previewyoutube]

As you know, wishlists are a huge help for a game about to launch, so please head over to the page to give Flathead both a wishlist and follow! We’re looking forward to everything the XP Ultra program has in store, so your support means a ton.

-The DreadXP Crew

notes.title: The Mortuary Assistant is Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h3][i]River Fields Mortuary is now open for Business![/i][/h3]

[previewyoutube=dc3Zn6KXito;full][/previewyoutube]
Step into the shoes of Rebecca, an apprentice at the [i]River Fields Mortuary[/i]. You've spent months learning the ropes of the embalming process and how to treat the bodies of the dearly departed. During your time in the office, you've heard rumors and murmurs of [i]possessions[/i] and [i]hauntings[/i] taking place behind the brick walls of the mortuary. But, with such a stigma around death and what happens when we die, it’s no surprise people make up stories around the dead.

That is, until, you receive a phone call to [b]come into work one stormy night...[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527154/6416f197f783f0885474e33c627f909506981b94.gif[/img]

There are [i]multiple endings[/i] and plenty of secrets to uncover in [b]The Mortuary Assistant[/b], so keep on embalming after your first go around! 

Perform embalmings, handle the various jobs around the mortuary, and exorcise demonic forces. All in a day’s work.

notes.title: A Big Thank You from the Team!
notes.notes:
Hey there [i]Cosmic Travelers[/i], 

It's been [b]two weeks[/b] since the release of [b]Dread X Collection 5[/b], and it's been an [i]absolute[/i] blast to watch players go through the launcher and metagames within! 

We also want to say that we appreciate the community's patience with any issues they've come across during their stay at Outpost 3000! Collections like these are a unique breed, development-wise, and there were definitely some bumps along the road for the ol' Clown Car. But we're happy with how it came together, and seeing the creative talent of all these developers come to fruition is always a treat for us! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/72feac26976c85f380e9de8a09075b9ceed2a36b.png[/img]

If you enjoyed your time with the game,[b][i] it'd mean a lot to us if you could leave a review on Steam[/i][/b]! And if you haven't picked up the game yet? Well, what are you waiting for!

[hr][/hr]
[h2][u]A closer look at the Twelve Games:[/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/9c055b85c87d530587442bcbd0016e16c1073a64.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]HUNSVOTTI[/b], by [i]Roope Tamminen:[/i][/h3] Finland, [i]1888[/i]. The locals are celebrating Juhannus, a nightless night in midsummer said to hold magical power. A ritual must be completed.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/1c703e15081c61070b38163c5824b72db406eeb3.png[/img]
[h3][b]Gallerie[/b], by [i]Shakles:[/i][/h3] The paint [i]whispers[/i] in an infamous art gallery where mysterious disappearances have occurred.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/169d6e61a97c2cb4ef8efc353ceeb369fe333e0a.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]The Book of Blood[/b], by [i]Darkstone Digital:[/i][/h3] The night signals closing time at Pomeroy Grasslands carnival and its employee Trevor volunteers to lock up. Alone in his booth, with a strange book in Lost and Found, a man steps out of the darkness and hands Trevor a note: “[i]let me in.[/i]”
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/bfa4b473c8ee98ebbffc8b637e07089a99d98353.png[/img]
[h3][b]Karao[/b], by [i]Stroboskop:[/i][/h3] A late night of karaoke. A wrong turn. Singing? Where did the train station come from, and where does it go?
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/a1767fd8f44c3ca2b38507ee6863e66d02a3666c.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Rotten Stigma[/b], by [i]VisceralError:[/i][/h3] 12 children disappeared at the Gallagher Sports Center in 2006. Neal, a retired policeman, finds the courage to investigate.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/6fa77914b27cb65f9c3a51210660b0ab29a4f693.png[/img]
[h3][b]Spirit Guardian[/b], by [i]Nikk F.[/i]:[/h3] A daycare haunted by something sinister. Cries for help echo from its empty halls.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/6498ac77d975c13df4eaa2cf6f56606ab54fb1ce.png[/img]
[h3][b]We Never Left[/b], by [i]FYRE Games[/i]:[/h3] On a dark and stormy night in 1983, the phone rings. “[b]FINISH THE GAME[/b]”.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/3befcd1c349d24e968b654329500992142b3ab8f.png[/img]
[h3][b]Vestige[/b], by [i]Philip Hasselback:[/i][/h3] An old video game from childhood. A familiar place. A dark memory breaks through.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/345b753cc85b9e73f80081b682d833e832b93814.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Resver[/b], by [i]Colorfiction:[/i][/h3] It’s the twentieth anniversary of the tragic fire that claimed dozens of lives at the legendary Resver nightclub in [i]1992[/i]. An invitation arrives. It’s time for a night to remember at the resurrected Resver.
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/122a6f81443427070d957bb96e92d6db0cc0912f.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Ludomalica[/b], by [i]iwilliams[/i]:[/h3] It’s past midnight and mom and dad are gone for the weekend. There’s no better time than now to try playing [i]Ludomalica[/i]. It’s just a board game, right? But something feels… [i]wrong[/i].
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083692/c79c9eee073dd89814e3bc482b9a13f83314c06e.png[/img]
[h3][b]Beyond the Curtain[/b], by [i]Matt Reeves[/i]:[/h3] A young child falls asleep during a puppet show and awakes alone in an old, musty theater. Finding all the doors to be bricked over, the child must face the darkness that lies [i]beyond the curtains[/i].
